parameters.name: Host
parameters.description: The endpoint of the database instance. You can call the [ListInstances](~~141936~~) operation to obtain the endpoint.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: The port number that is used to connect to the database instance. You can call the [ListInstances](~~141936~~) operation to obtain the port number.

parameters.name: Sid
parameters.description: The system ID (SID) of the database instance. You can call the [ListInstances](~~141936~~) operation to obtain the SID.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description: The ID of the tenant. You can call the [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) operation to obtain the tenant ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise get-instance --tid 2000 --host 172.17.XXX.XXX --port 5432 --sid test --real-login-user-uid example-string --region cn-hangzhou
